description: Glass-style Windows desktop organizer with auto-sorting fences, drag-and-drop organization, and widgets.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "GlassDesk MSI not found: $msi" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "GlassDesk MSI installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "GlassDesk MSI not found: $msi. Refusing to remove Scoop files while Windows Installer registration may remain." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "GlassDesk MSI uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Uses the publisher's per-user MSI, which registers an HKCU startup entry and Start Menu shortcut. The upstream repository does not publish a license for the GlassDesk application.
